summary: Tested free-build AoE-style city layout feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend: critical issues found in 2 flows (Estradas tab is empty and clicking non-town_hall buildings opens the wrong panel).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Estradas' tab pane is EMPTY. No 'build-road-btn' nor any road-related UI is rendered when build-tab-roads is active. User has no way to enter road-build mode from the UI. The only buttons inside [data-testid='build-menu'] are the 5 tabs + civil items (build-item-house, build-item-garden). Switching tabs does not change the rendered items list when 'Estradas' is selected.

Clicking [data-testid='building-farm'] opens the Câmara Municipal panel instead of the Farm panel. The opened building-panel shows title 'Câmara Municipal' and the protection text 'A Câmara Municipal é o coração da cidade — não pode ser movida nem demolida'. As a consequence, move-building-btn and demolish-building-btn are never reachable for any non-town_hall building. Likely cause: town_hall sprite z-index/hit-area overlaps adjacent tiles, or onClick is bound to wrong building id. Confirmed via building-panel innerText reading 'Câmara Municipal Nível 1/5' even though the click target was building-farm at (5,5).

Build items show only 'Fundos insuficientes' generic text. After adding 1000 coins via /api/game/add-resources, Casa and Jardim still show 'Fundos insuficientes' because the missing resource is wood/stone, not coins. The label is misleading — should indicate which resource is missing (e.g. 'Madeira insuficiente' / 'Pedra insuficiente').
Spec mentions data-testid 'close-panel-btn' but the actual close button uses 'building-panel-close'. Minor naming inconsistency.

integration_issues.issue: Could not validate end-to-end build flow because (a) the test student has only 8 wood / 7 stone — insufficient even for the cheapest building (Jardim needs 10 wood, 5 stone), and (b) Estradas tab does not render the road builder, so the user cannot first build a road to test placement.
Cannot reach move/demolish flow from UI because clicks on non-town_hall buildings route to town_hall panel (see ui_bug above).

passed_tests: BACKEND: GET /api/game/city/layout returns grid_size 14, roads list, buildings with positions and migration cross-roads around town_hall (6,6)
BACKEND: POST /api/game/city/build rejects placement without adjacent road (400 'estrada')
BACKEND: Full build → duplicate-build (400) → move → demolish cycle with 50% refund
BACKEND: POST /api/game/city/road/build and /road/remove with connectivity validation and 50% refund (refund.wood == 2)
FRONTEND: Student login, tutorial skip, Minha Cidade tab loads isometric map with town_hall and cross-roads
FRONTEND: build-menu, all 5 tabs (build-tab-civil/education/resources/military/roads), sound-toggle-btn, city-tile-X-Y, building-town_hall present
FRONTEND: Affordable items not disabled, unaffordable items disabled with 'Fundos insuficientes' label and blur
FRONTEND: Town hall panel correctly omits move-building-btn and demolish-building-btn (only upgrade)
FRONTEND: Tab switching (Civil/Educação/Recursos/Militar/Estradas) does not throw errors
action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Estradas tab — render the road-build/remove UI (button [data-testid='build-road-btn']) when 'build-tab-roads' is active. Currently the tab pane only renders building items, not road actions.

FIX (CRITICAL): Clicks on non-town_hall buildings (e.g. building-farm) currently open the Câmara Municipal panel. Audit the onClick handler / z-index / hit-test in IsometricCity / CityGrid so the correct building.id is passed to BuildingPanel.

IMPROVE: BuildMenu affordability label should specify the missing resource (Moedas / Madeira / Pedra / Ferro) instead of generic 'Fundos insuficientes', because items can be blocked by non-coin resources.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend city layout logic is well-isolated and tested (test_city_layout.py covers 6 scenarios including connectivity).
Frontend IsometricCity click handling appears to misroute clicks to town_hall; needs inspection of CityGrid inverse isometric transform and building click priority.
BuildMenu road tab is missing its content panel — likely a switch/case branch that returns empty for category === 'roads'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 city layout tests + regression endpoints pass)
success_rate.frontend: ~55% (data-testids and UI render correctly, but 2 critical interactions broken)

seed_data_creation: Added 1000 coins to student via POST /api/game/add-resources?coins=1000 during testing. Did not modify wood/stone/iron.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend free-build endpoints all work. Frontend has 2 critical regressions: (1) Estradas tab pane is EMPTY — no road build/remove buttons. Verify BuildMenu category switch includes a 'roads' branch. (2) Clicking building-farm (or any non-town_hall building) opens the town_hall panel — likely the building.id passed to BuildingPanel is hardcoded or click event bubbles to town_hall sprite. After fixes, re-run: open Minha Cidade → check build-tab-roads renders build-road-btn → click building-farm and verify panel title shows 'Quinta' with move-building-btn and demolish-building-btn → run test_city_layout.py for regression. Student needs more wood/stone (db.game_states.update_one) to fully test the build flow UI.

rca of the issue.estradas_empty_tab: Likely BuildMenu only iterates over CITY_BUILDING_COSTS items by category; the 'roads' category has no entries in that map so the pane renders empty. The road-specific action button (build-road-btn) was not added to the roads branch.
rca of the issue.farm_click_opens_town_hall: Possible root causes: (a) the building sprite for town_hall has a wider hitbox/larger z-index covering adjacent tiles where farm is rendered; (b) the onClick in the sprite passes the wrong id; (c) the click is delegated to the tile-level handler which always resolves to the nearest large building (town_hall). Confirmed reproducible: clicking [data-testid='building-farm'] consistently yields panel with title 'Câmara Municipal'.
